description:
Detects poisoning of RAG response caches that serve malicious content to multiple users

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_032", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%rag%' AND "value" > 0
